newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks stabilise in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks stabilise in London.

text.p: Japanese stocks were steady in London after taking a dive in Tokyo overnight, dealers said. By 1435 GMT, the Nikkei 50 index was up 2.83 points to 1,699.71.
In Tokyo, the benchmark Nikkei 225 index tumbled 527.05, or 2.6 percent, to 19,804.38.
"People were a bit shell shocked and no one can come up with a sensible reason for the why it happened," said one London dealer, referring to Tokyo's overnight drop.
He noted some bargain hunting in those shares especially hard hit at the Tokyo close.
Shares in TDK Corp, for example, were about 100 yen above Tokyo's closing level.
Dealers said a sharp sell-off on Wall Street had only a small impact on Japanese shares here.
"Volumes are very light. People are taking a wait and see attitude, but we're looking for a bounce next week," the dealer said.
